description: This source file initializes a React application by rendering the 'App' component into the DOM element with id 'root'. It sets up the React rendering root and wraps the application within React's strict mode for highlighting potential issues.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a React root for rendering the React component tree into a specified DOM element.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the DOM, in this case, wrapping 'App' within React.StrictMode.
